testSelect.honestyText: PashuPoshan operates as a rapid screening, measurement, and decision-support tool. It explicitly refers suspect, contaminated, or out-of-domain samples to accredited state veterinary laboratories. RGB photography alone is never claimed to estimate protein, NDF, or invisible urea.

download.title: Download PashuPoshan for Android
download.subtitle: Official signed APK release (v1.0) with offline-first support, native camera capture, and on-device storage.
download.step1Desc: Tap the download button above to download PashuPoshan.apk to your phone.
download.step2Desc: Tap the downloaded notification or locate the APK in your phone's 'Downloads' folder. If prompted with 'For your security, your phone is not allowed to install unknown apps', tap Settings and enable 'Allow from this source'.
download.step3Desc: If Google Play Protect displays a prompt because the app was downloaded directly instead of the Play Store, tap 'More details' followed by 'Install anyway'.
download.step4Desc: Open PashuPoshan, allow Camera access for instant optical scans, and begin testing feed & silage!
download.featuresTitle: Why install the Android Native App?
download.feature1: Fast Native Camera with autofocus and flash controls for field imaging
download.feature2: Complete offline functionality with on-device SQLite / IndexedDB cache
download.feature3: Natural hardware back button navigation and immersive dark mode
download.feature4: Zero data consumption after install for remote farm operations
download.qrTitle: Scan with Phone Camera to Download
download.qrSubtitle: Open your phone camera or QR scanner to download the APK directly to your device.
